name: Menu Twig
description: Lets menu-administrators attach a Twig/HTML snippet to a menu link that is rendered in place of (or alongside) the link, via a custom Twig link() function.
project_description:
Menu twig is a Drupal module that provides text-area to render the HTML or twig extensions.

 This module provides flexibility to exclude the menu item and rewrite code in your own pattern.

 This module provides text area where you can also render the custom blocks and view blocks.

To enhance the module capability you can enable twig_tweak module so that we can also render the blocks inside the menu item.

 Features 
 
 Menu Twig module provides the text area with full HTML tags support. 
 Menu Twig module provides the flexibility to exclude the menu item. 
 Menu Twig allows HTML or twig syntax and can rewrite the menu structure code. 
 Menu Twig enhances the capability by enable module i.e twig_tweak. The text area supports the twig syntax please find some examples . 
 
 Note: If we use some twig extensions like twig_tweak you can achieve more complex structure like mega menu.
